name: between_edges_gives_the_height_past_a_chamfer
why: REPORT 8CD843, ROUND 22 (28/10/2026). On the drawing of 26P000007 the position of the rib, the width of the channel and the overall heights could not be dimensioned: «drawing_dimension» dimensioned the length of ONE edge, and the vertical edges cut by the 0.4 chamfer would have printed 5,45 instead of 5,85. «between» dimensions the distance of two parallel edges, read back against their distance on the sheet. The same round asked the row, the side, a text on the dimension, the parentheses, the arrows where the text is, the scale of a section, the style of the detail circle and moving a dimension: each is asked here and read back.
defect_caught: A distance between two edges that is the length of one of them, a pair of perpendicular or oblique edges dimensioned anyway, «between» mixed with «edges», a text or parentheses asked and not on the sheet, arrows outside a text that sits inside, a section that keeps the scale of its view, a detail circle in another style or free to move, a dimension that does not go where it was asked.
_why_these_numbers: The plate of «chamfer_dimension_matches_its_feature», 120 x 80 x 10 with the top back edge chamfered 3 x 6. Its side view V3 shows five edges: the bottom (80), the top cut by the chamfer, the front vertical (10), the back vertical cut by the chamfer, and the oblique chamfer. The ten pairs of «between» hold two parallel pairs: the two verticals, 80 apart (a horizontal distance, placed first), and the two horizontals, 10 apart, the overall height that the cut vertical edge does not give. The other eight are perpendicular or take the oblique edge. If V3 shows another count of edges, the first step says it: then the probe of the edges comes first.
